questions.question: In a certain code language, 'WASTE' is coded as '60' and 'BRANDED' is coded as '84'. What is the code for 'CEILINGFANS' in the given code language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Number of letters in the given word × 12 = Code for the word

'WASTE' is coded as '60' 

 
• 5 × 12 = 60

'BRANDED' is coded as '84'

 
• 7 × 12 = 84

Similarly,

'CEILINGFANS' 

 
• 11 × 12 = 132

Hence, '**132**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 19 June 2001 is Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 14 August 2007?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 19 June 2001 is Tuesday, then the day on these dates will be:

19 June 2002 → Wednesday

19 June 2003 → Thursday

32 : 65 and 35 : 71

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All Indians are Americans.

Some Chinese are Americans.

All Chinese are Russians.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Chinese are Indians is a possibility.

(II) No Russian is an Indian.

(III) Some Americans are Russians.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4555c25783bf538fe22b35b281b87aaa999bc3462f0a6e3ca2f4fe69948065cf.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Chinese are Indians is a possibility. → **Follows** (As, there is no definite relation between Chinese are Indians, it is possible that some Chinese are Indians)

(II) No Russian is an Indian. → Does not follow (As, there is no definite relation between Russian and Indian. Hence, false) 

(III) Some Americans are Russians. → Follows (As, Some Chinese are Americans and All Chinese are Russians, which implies some Americans are Russians)

Hence, ‘**Both conclusions I and III follow**’ is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

• 315 : 63 : 313 → 315 ÷ 5 = 63 and 315 - 2 = 313

• 235 : 47 : 233 → 235 ÷ 5 = 47 and 235 - 2 = 233

questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following pairs.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. The logic followed here is: **(First number × 6) + 3 = Second number.**

For, 16, 99

(16 × 6) + 3

96 + 3 = 99

99 = Second number.

For, 13, 81

(13 × 6) + 3

78 + 3 = 81

81 = Second number.

Similarly,

9, 57 

(9 × 6) + 3

54 + 3 = 57

57 = Second number.

So, the correct pair of number is** 9, 57.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***

questions.question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group? 

(1) 4 - 27

(2) 6 - 125

(3) 7 - 216

(4) 5 - 63
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First number - 1)³ = Second number

 
• 4 - 27 → (4 - 1)³ = 3³ = 27
 
• 6 - 125 → (6 - 1)3 = 53 = 125
 
• 7 - 216 → (7 - 1)3 = 63 = 216
 
• **5 - 63 → (5 - 1)3 = 43 = 64 ≠ 63**

Hence, '**4**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that does NOT represent a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Astonishing : Incredible
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **Words are synonyms of each other.

 
• Astonishing : Incredible → Astonishing is synonym of Incredible.

But, 

 
• Descend : Ascend → Descend is antonym of Ascend.

Hence, '**Descend : Ascend**' is the correct answer.
